title: 森林小鹿
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled. Subject: one lovable baby fawn takes a playful bow toward ONE oversized broad autumn leaf lying on the ground. Big expressive head tilted sideways, smooth rounded ears, elegant curved neck, chunky short legs and one broad tail. One large belly patch and TWO broad inner ears are the only body divisions; NO spots, NO fur, NO antlers, NO hoof lines. Solid black dot eyes with NO white highlights, solid black nose, single open smile stroke, NO closed mouth cavity. Leaf divided by ONLY ONE broad curving vein, no thin leaf stalk. Empty white background and one broad ground sweep only, no forest, branches, flowers, butterflies or extra props. Plan only 8–10 generous colorable areas, every area wider than 5% of the picture; absolutely no thin outline loops or enclosed sliver gaps between legs. The organic pose and curious gesture should be delightful, not a geometric diagram.
revisionPrompt: Change ONLY the ground/horizon line in this illustration: remove the entire horizontal curved ground line behind and between the fawn's legs, leaving continuous blank white background there, so no little white wedge is enclosed by the horizon and legs. Keep the adorable fawn, its face, pose, proportions, all other bold contours and the broad autumn leaf exactly the same. Do not add anything. Simple professional black line art on pure white, no shading, no text.
